news.analysis: Skattebo missed the previous game with a hamstring injury but he was a difference-maker for the Giants in Week 10. The second-year runner found on the end zone twice, on runs of one and 13 yards. Skattebo has run for 496 yards and four touchdowns while catching 14 passes for 120 yards in eight games this year. He will be an RB2 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.
news.contents: Cam Skattebo carried the ball 18 times for 78 yards and two touchdowns while catching three of his four targets for 44 yards on Thursday night in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.title: Cam Skattebo scores two TDs in Week 10

news.contents: New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo rushed for 78 yards and two touchdowns on 18 carries in Thursday night's 24-21 home loss to the Washington Commanders. He added 44 yards on 3-of-4 receiving. The second-year pro out of Arizona State missed Week 9's win over the Eagles with a hamstring injury, but was back out in full force for this one, running with his signature ferocity en route to his second career multi-touchdown performance. After Skattebo's soft benching back in Week 6, when he ...
news.title: Cam Skattebo Excels in Loss

news.analysis: Diggs had his best game of the season in the close win over the Giants on Thursday night. The veteran wideout caught the game-winning touchdown on a 32-yard pass from Jayden Daniels with 57 seconds left in regulation. Diggs has shown a nose for the end zone in his first season in Washington, catching six touchdowns in eight games. He will be a fantasy WR3 in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.
news.contents: Stefon Diggs caught six of his 10 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10.
news.title: Stefon Diggs goes for 83 yards, TD in Week 10

news.contents: Washington Commanders wide receiver Stefon Diggs caught six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in his team's 24-21 win against the hosting New York Giants. The target and receiving totals were new season highs for the veteran, as he'd mostly disappointed with fewer than 56 yards in all seven of his appearances until Thursday's victory. news.analysis: Moore had a big game in his return to action against the Ravens in Week 8. He couldn't replicate the effort in Week 9, but he is healthy and stronger fantasy performances should be on the way. Moore is best viewed as a low-end WR2 or high-end WR3.
